Preserve the slight10-15degree forward torso inclination, chin tucked, low controlled bent-knee tactical posture. BOTH ARMS/HANDS and all guns/ammo/effects MUST BE ABSENT from output; restore a complete jacket torso under the missing arms for independent arm layers. The legs/feet must now form a MUCH NARROWER stance than reference: keep shoes directly UNDER the pelvis, both feet within a total horizontal span about35-45 logical pixels on a120px canvas, foot centers about15-22px apart. NO leg stretched far forward/back, no wide lunge, no running stride. Quiet FOREFOOT/BALL-OF-FOOT weight, heels gently RAISED2-4 logical pixels, toes touch floor, bent knees cushion the motion; not ballerina pointe shoes or upright exaggerated prancing. Existing wine flat shoes, clear toe-down/heel-up angle and toe contact. Same right-facing side/three-quarter view, same body scale/head/torso location in every cell, silhouette about106px tall, max1px head bob, wide transparent margins, all hair and entire shoes inside each cell. Crisp stepped pixel art around26 opaque colors, dark plum contours, large coherent clusters, no blur/gradients/noisy dither. Genuine transparent background and limb/cell gaps; no ground/shadow/grid/labels/text, no weapons, arms or props. PRIMARY REQUEST: revise tactical walking into VERY SHORT STEPS ON THE TOES with a tightly controlled upper body. EXACT SIX sequential poses in3COLUMNS x2ROWS, row-major. F1front/near toe contacts just half a shoe ahead of back foot, both heels lifted; F2weight transfers over front toes, back toes release, feet stay close; F3rear/far foot passes beneath pelvis a few pixels forward, near forefoot supports; F4opposite toe contacts only half a shoe ahead, both heels still raised; F5opposite weight transfer; F6near foot passes beneath pelvis back toF1. Actual alternating near/far legs, small advances only, both shoes remain under hips throughout. The key difference is NARROW short-step forefoot gait, not the previous big stride. Keep torso leaned and steady in all six; do not merely rotate or mirror one copied leg.
assets.status: Superseded by toe correction and alpha extraction

assets.name: WalkToeCorrection
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the provided6-frame3columns x2rows armless Sundeok body atlas. Keep EXACT canvas size and all6 cell positions. Keep the head/face/gray curls, forward-lean torso, complete mustard jacket, colors/style/character scale EXACTLY as supplied. Change ONLY the lower legs/feet to make the gait clearly VERY SHORT QUIET TIPTOE/FOREFOOT walking. The current reference is still too wide and the support/front shoe looks too flat: bring both feet much closer directly under the hips, reducing the total horizontal footprint span by ANOTHER25-30percent. Each frame should have foot centers only about one shoe-length apart, a very narrow compact stance. On the support/front foot, the TOE/BALL touches the floor while the HEEL is VISIBLY RAISED with a CLEAR TRANSPARENT AIR GAP underneath the back half of the sole, around3-5 logical pixels at120px character scale. Tilt the entire existing wine shoe toe-down/heel-up about15-25degrees. Do not redraw it as a flat planted horizontal sole or pointy ballet shoe. The back/swing foot also has heel lifted, toes tucked downward, and stays close to the other ankle; bent knees cushion the small steps. Six genuine alternating near/far steps: front toe touch, weight shift, rear toe passing under hips, opposite toe touch, opposite transfer, other toe passing; close and controlled all the way through. No long reaching leg, no wide lunge, no exaggerated high-knee skipping. Head and torso unchanged and steady; clear wine slip-on shoes/pale soles, loose plum floral pants unchanged except small ankle/knee bends needed. Both arms/hands/weapon still absent. Full bodies wholly inside6cells, no overlap/crop. Maintain genuine transparent alpha incl gaps between shoes and underneath raised heels. No added shadow/ground/glow/grid/text. Crisp warm pixel-art clusters, no smooth airbrush. The result must look like careful forefoot/tiptoe steps rather than ordinary heel-to-toe walking.
assets.status: Pose refinement; alpha repaired in next tool edit
